integrity: The proof is self-contained for all orders; finite exact checks are supporting evidence. Prior spectral capacity is explicitly attributed. Whole text of a relevant 2003 source was inaccessible; originality is provisional to the cited comparison and residual risks.
scientific_limitations: Equal-quality unweighted tree dispersal matrices, uniform conditional sample of exactly three viable patches, deterministic mean-field spectral persistence threshold; finite stochastic extinction times, weighted/cyclic graphs and other survivor budgets are excluded.
title: A sharp three-survivor metapopulation-capacity reversal on tree landscapes
